data.name: 8 Days at the Motel
data.detailed_description:
You’ve been hired to work the night shift at an old roadside motel.

Your job sounds simple:

Inspect the motel. Remember what you see. Report anything that changes.

But as the days pass, the motel begins to feel less familiar.

A picture may change.

An object may disappear.

A door that was closed may suddenly be open.

Someone may be standing where nobody was before.

Or perhaps...

nothing has changed at all.

SURVIVE 8 DAYS

Complete your cleaning shifts and make it through all 8 days. As the days pass, the motel becomes increasingly unpredictable and disturbing.

Complete your inspection correctly to progress to the next day.

As you move forward, expect increasingly strange events and encounters throughout the motel.

Your goal is simple:

Make it through all 8 days.

SPOT THE ANOMALIES

Pay close attention to your surroundings and memorize the motel.

Anomalies can appear in different forms. Some will be impossible to miss. Others may be hiding in the smallest details.

When you've finished your inspection, you must make a decision.

DANGER : You noticed an anomaly.

SAFE : Everything appears normal.

FOLLOW THE RULES

The motel has rules.

They are there for a reason.

Read the instructions carefully. Remember where things belong. Don't trust everything you see.

And most importantly...

Do not open any door you were told to leave closed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200g
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
